🔥 शाहरुख खान के बर्थडे पर मिला फैंस को बड़ा तोहफा, फिल्म King का पहला गाना Tu Mil Jaaye हुआ रिलीज!

गाने में शाहरुख और Deepika Padukone का जबरदस्त रोमांस दिख रहा है, और दोनों पुरानी यादें ताजा कर रहे हैं।

गाने की शुरुआत में शाहरुख खुद को कातिल नहीं बल्कि आशिक बता रहे हैं, जो बंदूक के साथ स्माइल करते नजर आए।

वीडियो के एक ब्लिंक-एंड-मिस सीन में जलते हुए घर के सामने पीठ करके एक लड़की खड़ी है।

फैन का मानना है कि यह Suhana Khan हो सकती है, जो फिल्म की कास्ट का हिस्सा भी हैं।

इस गाने में Arijit Singh और Madhubanti Bagchi की आवाज है, साथ ही Ed Sheeran का इंग्लिश रैप भी शामिल है।

Director Siddharth Anand की यह फिल्म theaters में 24 दिसंबर 2026 को रिलीज होगी।

क्या आपको भी इस गाने में सुहाना खान की झलक दिखी? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇🎬

ctx.title: Shah Rukh Khan’s King song Tu Mil Jaaye has fans speculating about Suhana Khan’s surprise appearance
ctx.summary: On his 61st birthday, Shah Rukh Khan released Tu Mil Jaaye, a romantic song featuring him with Deepika Padukone. Fans believe they have spotted Suhana Khan too.
ctx.text:
Shah Rukh Khan gave fans a special treat on his 61st birthday by releasing the first song, Tu Mil Jaaye , from his much-anticipated film King. The romantic track features Shah Rukh romancing Deepika Padukone , bringing back memories of their previous collaborations, including Pathaan and Jawan. However, fans were quick to spot what they believe could be a glimpse of Suhana Khan in a blink-and-miss scene in the song.
The song opens with Shah Rukh declaring that he is not a 'qaatil' (killer), but an 'aashiq' (lover), as he is seen flaunting a gun with a charming smile. The following scenes show him completely smitten by Deepika as the two romance each other against breathtaking locations across the world.
The visuals then quickly shift to reveal the fiercer side of Shah Rukh's character, showing him in action as he takes on his enemies. One blink-and-miss scene features a girl standing with her back to the camera in front of a burning house.
Fans believe the girl could be Suhana Khan, who is also part of the film's cast. Sharing their guesses online, one person commented, "I guess this is suhana khan from the new song of #King." Another wrote, "Suhana khan? #King."
A third fan speculated about her character's storyline, writing, "Does Suhana khan's character die here, or she meet Rani's character and eventually become the main lead? Whatever the situation, one thing is certain: the father-daughter emotions in #King are going to be absolute MAYHEM. ❤️‍🩹🔥"
The song features vocals by Arijit Singh and Madhubanti Bagchi, along with an English rap segment by Ed Sheeran. The music has been composed by Sachin-Jigar, with Hindi lyrics penned by Kumaar and the English rap written by Ed Sheeran. The choreography is by Piyush and Shazia.
Shah Rukh took to social media at midnight to share the song with fans. Sharing it, he wrote, "This era of love is bestowed upon the fortunate ones... Where roses bloom amidst the fragrance of gunpowder...Of Love and other Battles...This December, #LoveLikeAKing #TuMilJaaye song out now! #KING."
King is an upcoming action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand and produced by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures. The film stars Shah Rukh Khan and features an ensemble cast including Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Anil Kapoor, Jaideep Ahlawat and Abhay Verma, among others.
The film marks Suhana's theatrical debut. It is scheduled to release in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026.
